say:1:1320623001:1.text: Master Hugin, how is my brother doing?
say:1:1320623001:1.source_cn: 呼金先生，请问哥哥他情况怎么样……？

say:2:1320623002:1.text: Oh, Missy. If I knew how to fix him, he would be here greeting you instead of me.
say:2:1320623002:1.source_cn: 唉，小姑娘，要是我能想出任何办法，他早就运转着迎接你们了！

say:3:1320623003:1.text: It's alright. We've brought back my brother's remains, and soon he'll find peace.
say:3:1320623003:1.source_cn: 没关系，先生，我们已经把哥哥的遗骸带回来了，他马上就能...

say:4:1320623004:1.text: I can use magic to extract Callan's soul from the golem and return it to his remains.

say:5:1320623005:0.text: He needs to return to the place from whence he came and proceed to where he belongs, so that his soul may find peace once more.
say:5:1320623005:0.source_cn: 从来处来，往归处去，这样他的灵魂才能重获些许宁静。

say:11:1320623009:1.text: Family honor means a lot to my brother. At his coming-of-age ceremony, my father gave him a ruby ​​signet ring with our family crest engraved upon it.
say:11:1320623009:1.source_cn: ……哥哥很重视家族的荣耀。成年礼上，父亲交给他一枚红宝...

say:12:1320623010:1.text: I still remember my father's words. "From this day onward, you will officially represent the Radinov family. Your words will hold weight, and your actions will be scrutinized. Always remember your station, Callan."
say:12:1320623010:1.source_cn: “从今天起，你将正式代表拉季诺夫，你的语言将被聆听，行...

say:13:1320623011:1.text: The moment my brother put on the signet ring, it marked his acceptance of the family's duties and obligations... Since then, I have never seen him remove it.
say:13:1320623011:1.source_cn: 哥哥带上那枚象征长子的印戒，也等于接过了家族的责任和负...

say:14:1320623012:1.text: If we're lucky, that ring should still be on Callan's hand.
say:14:1320623012:1.source_cn: 如果蒙神垂怜，我们足够幸运，那枚印戒应该还戴在哥哥手上……

narration:15:1320623013:1.text: You all turn your attention back to Callan's remains, noticing a darkly gleaming ring on his withered right hand, seemingly encrusted with dried blood.
